origin: Authored paragraphs already saved in the product corpus; reordered by a fixed seed.
clean:
Finding a parcel

Use the order number from your receipt to open order tracking. The tracking number identifies the parcel with the courier, while order status describes our warehouse work. A delivery date is an estimate until the parcel reaches your local depot.

If the shipping address changed after checkout, contact customer support. Include the old delivery address and the new one in a private support ticket. Do not post an email address in a public review.

Returning one item

A return label can be downloaded from your account. Check the return window before sending the parcel. The shipping label used for the original delivery cannot be reused as a return label.

A partial refund applies when only part of the order is returned. Refund status is updated after the warehouse checks the item. Keep the postal receipt until payment confirmation arrives.

Paying for an order

The payment method is shown on the invoice. If payment failed, review the billing address and ask your bank whether the transaction was declined. A duplicate authorization is not necessarily a second payment.

A discount code is applied before sales tax. The currency is displayed at checkout. A gift card and store credit can cover part of the balance, with the remaining amount paid by another payment method.

Choosing a product

The product page lists each product variant and its current stock. Use the size guide before adding an item to your basket. An out of stock variant can be added to saved items so you can check it later.

The warranty period is recorded on the receipt. A replacement part may solve a small fault without replacing the complete product. Include a photo and the invoice number when opening a warranty support ticket.

Collecting a delivery

A pickup point may request the tracking number and proof of identity. The courier sends a notification when the parcel is available. Read the delivery instructions before travelling to collect it.

A warehouse delay can move the delivery date by one business day. A weekend or holiday may affect support hours. For urgent changes use the contact form and include your order number.

Using the mobile site

The mobile app and browser share your account settings. A screen reader can announce checkout errors and form labels. If a photo upload fails, check the attachment size before trying file upload again.

Accessibility feedback can be sent through the contact form. Do not attach an invoice containing another customer's billing address. A support ticket can be reopened if the requested attachment was missing.

Subscriptions and gifts

A subscription renewal produces a new invoice and payment confirmation. You can review the subscription in your account or cancel order dispatch before the displayed cutoff. Cancellation rules are listed in the privacy policy and service terms.

A gift message is printed separately from the receipt. International shipping may require a customs charge. The courier will explain how customs clearance affects the delivery date.

I ordered a dock and two cables for a shared desk at home. The parcel arrived on Thursday and the outside of the box looked fine. After unpacking I noticed that the power connector on the dock was loose. I tried the original charger, a second cable and another socket before contacting support.

The support agent asked for photos of the label and the connector. I uploaded both through my account, but only the first photo appeared on the ticket. Please confirm whether the second attachment arrived. I do not want to send the same information several times.

If a replacement is available, I would prefer that to a refund. The cables work correctly and I would like to keep them. Please tell me whether I need to return the full order or just the faulty dock, and whether a collection can be arranged for next week.

The tracking page says that our parcel was delivered yesterday afternoon, but nobody at the address has received it. I checked with the reception desk and the neighbour who normally accepts deliveries when we are away. Neither of them has the parcel.

The courier photograph shows a doorway that does not look like our building. Our address was entered correctly at checkout and is printed correctly on the invoice. I have attached a photo of our entrance so that the local delivery team can compare it.

This was intended as a gift for the weekend. Please let us know whether the parcel can be recovered or whether another one can be dispatched. If there is an investigation number, I would appreciate a copy so that we can refer to the same case when calling support.

I bought the medium sleeve after checking the dimensions on the product page. The width is correct, but the opening is too narrow for the model shown in the compatibility list. I have not removed the labels or used the sleeve outside the house.

I started a return request in my account and selected an exchange for the larger size. The page then asked me to pay a second delivery charge even though the original order qualified for the advertised exchange service. I stopped before completing the payment.

Could you check the request and tell me what to do next? I can send a photo with a ruler if that helps. Please keep the exchange open while this is being reviewed, because I do not want to lose the larger size if the available stock changes.

support answered my question and sent the missing part the following morning.
i can open the invoice on my phone, but the download button does not respond.
the item was intended as a gift, so i selected the plain packaging option.
after the update the saved filters disappeared from the search page.
the new version is easier to read and the notifications arrive without a delay.
we tested the product during a short trip and the battery lasted for the whole day.
